item.description:
- Explain the chosen key under the Settings keyboard map, and assign a free key to an action from there. Pointing at a shortcut lights its key; a filtered shortcut group can be collapsed. Thanks to Andrey Markin (@Mark-Life) for the keyboard map refinements in this update. - Show audio levels for iPhone spatial-audio videos and other recordings whose extra tracks fall back to the main one. - Fit portrait and rotated Photos videos correctly, and keep them playable when their details are slow to read. - Keep Shift-click and Command-click selection the same while a folder opens and after it is ready. After browsing an opening folder, the first Esc no longer closes it; press Esc again to cancel. - Keep the next keyboard-selected Grid photo in view after a decision hides the current one. - Restore sharp 100% detail when panning away and back quickly, and free memory sooner when browsing fast. - Keep folders you use opening quickly, even after opening many others, and keep a first scan moving while you browse. - Step through photos in Gallery with less work per key, and decode JPEG XL photos half as often with Info open. - Open known folders quickly after a macOS update; photo and video details refresh in the background. - Show clipping cues soon after a folder opens: Louppe remembers earlier checks, estimates new photos from thumbnails, and measures a photo fully when you open it. - Save the folder's session file less often while rating quickly. - Drop the Done button from Filter and Sort: choices apply at once, and Esc or a click outside closes them. Reset is now an icon beside the title, and Sort has one too. - Keep dialog buttons and warning actions readable when labels are long, with the close button at the far right. Selection in inactive windows is neutral grey, and VoiceOver reads Sort and Filter titles as headings.
- Let Organize move photos without XMP beside hidden or similarly named files, and move shared XMP when all its owners keep their names and move together. - Protect XMP sidecars that another photo could own, including files added during review. - Keep a hidden current photo out of Command-click selection and Trash. - Refuse redirected source and destination paths in Copy and Organize, and let Copy work from a permitted subfolder of a restricted drive. - Finish interrupted Move recovery even when an emptied source or destination folder was removed, and keep recovery pending until restored files are safely saved. - Keep Photos originals that interrupted Copy recovery still needs, respect turned-off iCloud downloads for waiting requests, and keep file commands available while old Photos temporary files are removed. - Keep folder pins and positions safe when saves overlap or a write is interrupted, and tie saved decisions to verified file content. - Pair RAW files, including Hasselblad .3FR, with a same-named HEIC/HEIF or JPEG XL file when there is no JPEG. The grouped item shows its real type, such as RAW + HEIC. Thanks to 人民艺术家 (@Wanguy) for reporting this.
